An honest limit: 10 of the 50 assertions rest on sources that could not be read at all - paywalls, bot protection, video without a transcript. Those claims are neither confirmed nor corrected here, and a reader cannot check them either. They are the weakest part of this paper's evidence base. The audit was performed and applied by an AI agent fleet; no line of the corrected text has been read by a human editor. A reference that resolves is not thereby right - it was read before it was trusted.
